title: A Safehouse for the Protocol
author: Elodie Fairweather
blurb: Vesper Thornbury, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
